records.text: Owens said her operation sold no Charlie Kirk memorabilia after his death and ran no advertisements during its tribute episode.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We sold nothing with Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s face. ... No memorabilia, not a single item was sold by us in the aftermath of his death. ... And I would point out that in our tribute episode to Charlie (Charlie Kirk), our biggest episode by views ever, we ran zero ads. Zero. None.

verification.notes: The public tribute video is available and contains no host-read advertising or merchandise pitch in the transcript, which supports the zero-ad portion at the content level. However, platform-inserted advertising can vary and no public sales or inventory records establish that Owens's operation sold no Charlie Kirk memorabilia. The combined operational claim therefore remains unverifiable.
